scope: Additional dementia MRI cohorts for Kevin paper; no applications or contacts submitted. Research sources and file manifests only. This is a candidate register, not a claim of data acquired.
immediate_findings: OpenNeuro ds007561 v1.0.0 acquired and validated: 20 T1 subjects (1 AD, 5 MCI, 14 controls), clinical metadata, 45 source files, 297880860 bytes.
Besga Zenodo3935636 is open and NIH/NCBI indexed via PMC7658647; root inspecting/downloading.
counting_notes: Do not sum cohort participants, MRI sessions, images, slices or derived records as unique subjects.
Do not count a platform and its constituent cohorts separately.
Disease etiologies and severity scales need an explicit clinical mapping; FTD, DS-AD, preclinical risk and AD severity are different targets.

records.name: UCB-J PET and T1W Images for Synapse Project Cohort
records.raw_mri: Raw native-space T1w, 1 mm isotropic MPnRAGE_VFA; PET also present
records.size: 20 unique participants: 1 AD, 5 MCI, 14 controls; calculated directly from participants.tsv
records.clinical_metadata: Participant ID, age, gender, visit diagnosis, sessions
records.access: Acquired public release 1.0.0, CC0, no login/application. Pinned commit 4e23a0f47e955268df458729778f4d0ef1f2575a. All 20 T1w images verified against pinned SHA256 hashes and NIfTI integrity.
records.fit: Small external pilot or pipeline check; too few AD cases for reliable stand-alone performance estimates or training.
records.overlap: NIH-funded SYNAPSE, Wisconsin ADRC and WRAP; reconcile participant provenance before using alongside WRAP or NACC.

records.name: Alzheimer's Disease versus Bipolar Disorder versus Healthy Control MRI
records.raw_mri: NIfTI original DWI; T1 preprocessed 1 mm MNI; primary data paper says original and registered T1 are included, exact archive contents need inspection
records.population: AD, late-onset bipolar disorder, healthy controls
records.size: Subject counts require archive inspection; small cohort
records.clinical_metadata: Acquired approved demographics: 78 rows with source diagnosis code, random study ID, age and source gender code, plus separate plasma biomarker CSVs. The paper describes broader neuropsychological measures, NPI and FAST, but provider-ignored clinical_data_corrected.csv was not extracted or used; those scales are not verified usable acquired fields. Biomarker patient linkage and interpretation remain unaudited.
records.access: Zenodo publicly downloadable archives: Clinical_data.zip 317.8 kB; T1_preprocessed.zip 5.3 GB; total collection 16.3 GB
records.fit: Potential independent structural MRI plus clinical set; use AD/controls for AD task and keep bipolar separate. Root agent inspecting archive.

records.name: DZNE Longitudinal Cognitive Impairment and Dementia Study
records.raw_mri: Cranial MRI; exact sequences and QA availability discoverable through DZNE clinical data search tool
records.population: Healthy controls, subjective/mild memory impairment, mild dementia, first-degree relatives of AD patients
records.size: 1,000 study participants; not a verified complete-MRI count
records.clinical_metadata: Annual clinical interview, detailed neuropsychology, blood; optional CSF
records.access: DZNE request form and use regulations; external requests reviewed by CAB/CEB. Raw data not an unrestricted download.
records.fit: Strong independent AD-spectrum candidate; verify diagnostic classes, MRI completeness and approval.

records.name: European Prevention of Alzheimer's Dementia LCS V.IMI
records.raw_mri: Raw/processed NIfTI T1w and FLAIR; ASL/diffusion/rs-fMRI in ~70% subset
records.population: At-risk adults without dementia at enrollment
records.size: >2,000 participants; MRI availability/QC per subject must be checked
records.clinical_metadata: Cognition, biomarkers, sociodemographics, vital signs, genomics
records.access: AD Workbench workspace and dataset application; imaging request specifies sequences/formats and includes clinical access
records.fit: Useful preclinical/biomarker or MCI research; not a source of baseline established dementia cases.
records.overlap: Recruited through existing cohorts including PREVENT; do not assume independent from parent cohorts.

records.name: ALLFTD including ARTFL and LEFFTDS
records.raw_mri: Refaced raw MR images downloadable via approved LONI FTLD project; volumetric data also available
records.population: Frontotemporal lobar degeneration spectrum / familial at-risk participants
records.size: >3,000 clinical participants across ALLFTD and predecessors; not MRI subject count
records.clinical_metadata: Demographics, neuropsychology, function, diagnosis, disease severity, CDR+NACC FTLD; NfL subset
records.access: Research goals, analysis plan, qualified investigator and DUA; review generally 4–6 weeks. Minimal or full clinical data can accompany MRI.
records.fit: Differential diagnosis / FTD auxiliary cohort, not AD severity labels.
records.overlap: ARTFL and LEFFTDS are predecessors, not separate additive independent datasets; NACC-associated overlap possible.

records.name: Genetic Frontotemporal Dementia Initiative
records.raw_mri: 3T T1/T2, resting fMRI, ASL, DTI, NODDI, QSM
records.population: Symptomatic and presymptomatic genetic FTD, relatives/noncarriers
records.size: Official study page: 1,900 participants; MRI subset/release count not established
records.clinical_metadata: Standardized clinical history/exam, CBI-R, FRS, CDR+NACC FTLD, neuropsychology, genetics, CSF/blood
records.access: Central data access committee; primary GENFI paper describes reasonable requests through study website/GENFI team
records.fit: Genetic FTD auxiliary cohort; not substitute AD or universal dementia-stage labels.

records.name: Frontotemporal Lobar Degeneration Neuroimaging Initiative (NIFD in LONI)
records.raw_mri: Longitudinal structural MRI; diffusion and PET in subsets
records.population: bvFTD, semantic/nonfluent PPA, cognitively normal controls
records.size: Current unique raw-MRI participant count not verified; do not use selected-paper sample sizes as total
records.access: NIFD currently listed by LONI among studies one can apply to. Legacy cohort website inaccessible during lookup.
records.fit: FTD differential diagnosis only; reconcile overlap with UCSF/other FTD cohorts.

records.name: Four Repeat Tauopathy Neuroimaging Initiative / 4RTNI-2
records.raw_mri: MRI and tau-PET available by request for 4RTNI-2
records.population: PSP, corticobasal syndrome and variant tauopathy syndromes plus healthy controls
records.size: Current downloadable MRI counts not verified
records.clinical_metadata: Clinical, imaging, blood and CSF biomarkers through joint ALLFTD resource sharing
records.access: ALLFTD data request route; some imaging via LONI by request
records.fit: Related neurodegenerative differential diagnosis; not AD or automatic dementia labels.

records.name: Amsterdam Dementia Cohort
records.raw_mri: Clinical diagnostic MRI; sequence/scanner mix to establish
records.population: Clinical memory clinic cohort including SCD, MCI, AD, FTD, DLB
records.size: Official October 2025 institutional page: almost 7,000 clinical individuals, not verified MRI count
records.age: Mixed clinical referral ages; exact release range unverified
records.clinical_metadata: Extensive neuropsychology, clinical workup, EEG, CSF; many annual follow-ups
records.access: Institutional contact; cohort papers indicate reasonable-request sharing. No unrestricted raw MRI download verified.
records.fit: Strong real-world independent clinical test set if collaboration/access granted.

records.name: Alzheimer Biomarkers Consortium–Down Syndrome (including NiAD/ADDS predecessor components)
records.raw_mri: T1 structural, T2 FSE, FLAIR, T2*, ASL, DTI, resting fMRI; PET
records.population: Adults with Down syndrome, normal aging through MCI and dementia; sibling controls
records.size: 550 DS plus 50 sibling control recruitment target; not verified available MRI count; >50 sibling controls reported
records.clinical_metadata: Consensus diagnosis, demographics, medical/psychiatric history, neurological exam, caregiver tools, cognition, genetics
records.access: Qualified investigator request, NIH/study review, DUA, LONI after approval
records.fit: Separate Down-syndrome AD analysis; developmental/anatomical differences prevent naive pooling.
records.overlap: NiAD and ADDS were original ABC-DS teams; avoid treating as independent additive cohorts.

records.name: MEMENTO
records.raw_mri: T1/T2/FLAIR, diffusion, resting fMRI noted in DPUK matrix
records.population: Cognitive complaints or deficits without dementia at enrollment; longitudinal conversion
records.size: 2,323 participants enrolled; usable MRI count requires release inventory
records.age: DPUK imaging matrix lists 60+; confirm actual release criteria
records.clinical_metadata: Clinical, neuropsychological, psychiatric, lifestyle/family, imaging, biosamples
records.access: MEMENTO data access committee; application via DPUK; analysis remotely in secure environment, only approved aggregate results exported
records.fit: MCI/progression research and later dementia outcomes; baseline participants cannot be labeled dementia.

records.name: BioFIND dementia/MCI cohort
records.raw_mri: Structural T1 MRI with resting MEG
records.population: Approximately half MCI and half healthy controls
records.size: 324 participants reported; exact matched MRI/clinical availability to confirm
records.clinical_metadata: Cognitive group; clinical details/variables require dictionary
records.access: Exclusively DPUK according to cohort profile; approved research inside portal
records.fit: MCI vs control auxiliary/external cohort; not the Parkinson BIOFIND collection with same acronym.

records.name: Neuroimaging of Inflammation in Memory and Related Other Disorders
records.raw_mri: Structural and functional MRI plus PET
records.population: AD, DLB, FTD, PSP, late-onset depression, MCI and controls
records.size: 167 cohort participants in current DPUK imaging matrix; historical larger sample counts should not replace portal inventory
records.clinical_metadata: Neuropsychology, blood inflammation, diagnosis; longitudinal cognition in protocol
records.access: DPUK cohort approval and secure analysis
records.fit: Small diagnosis-specific subsets; primary protocol lacks longitudinal neuroimaging.

records.name: PREVENT Dementia (distinct from PREVENT-AD)
records.raw_mri: Multimodal MRI baseline and follow-up; raw images reviewed case by case
records.population: Midlife dementia-risk cohort, initially without dementia
records.size: 700 recruitment target; DPUK subset 210; neither is verified complete current raw MRI count
records.access: ADDI/AD Connect application approval; raw-image requests subject to imaging-team review
records.fit: Risk/preclinical work, not established AD training. Distinct study from Canadian PREVENT-AD.
records.overlap: Feeds EPAD and TriBEKA; participant overlap must be reconciled.

records.name: Amyloid imaging for phenotyping Lewy body dementia
records.raw_mri: T1, FLAIR, resting fMRI and diffusion indicated in DPUK matrix
records.population: Lewy body dementia, AD and controls
records.size: 80 cohort/planned participants; complete MRI count unverified
records.clinical_metadata: Clinical features and follow-up; exact fields need dictionary
records.fit: Small DLB/AD differential diagnosis cohort; not generic dementia-stage labels.

records.name: Quantitative MRI of Brain Structure and Function in NHS Memory Clinics
records.raw_mri: High-quality structural MRI with additional sequences; DPUK T1/T2/diffusion/resting fMRI
records.population: NHS memory clinic referrals undergoing structural imaging
records.size: 100 participants in DPUK matrix; a primary 2024 paper analyzes 272, so release scope must be confirmed
records.clinical_metadata: Clinical clinic dataset; age/sex/cognition/diagnosis details release dependent
records.access: DPUK cohort application; no unrestricted raw download verified
records.fit: Potential real-world clinical external validation; confirm MRI inventory and labels.

records.name: UK Biobank
records.raw_mri: Brain structural, functional, diffusion MRI; T1/FLAIR and other sequences
records.population: Population cohort, linked incident dementia outcomes; not dementia-enriched
records.size: >100,000 imaging attendees reported, not 100,000 dementia cases
records.clinical_metadata: Age, demographic/lifestyle, cognition, genetics, linked coded health records and algorithmic dementia outcomes
records.access: Official page says new applications paused; intends to reopen late 2026. Eligible institutional research plus legal agreement and UKB-RAP access.
records.fit: Conditional future risk/generalization dataset; health-record outcome timing must align with MRI.

platforms.name: DPUK
platforms.status: Controlled access platform, not an independent cohort
platforms.scope: >3,000 imaging participants across 20 imaging cohorts stated by imaging page; public overall portal counts (105 datasets/3.5M people) are not MRI counts
platforms.access: Application to each selected cohort; analysis stays in secure environment

excluded_or_not_counted.name: DementiaBank
excluded_or_not_counted.reason: Official catalog is language/audio/video; no usable raw structural MRI cohort verified.

excluded_or_not_counted.name: OpenNeuro ds004767
excluded_or_not_counted.reason: 55 ex-vivo medial temporal lobe specimens/atlas and histology; not comparable clinical whole-brain in-vivo training.

excluded_or_not_counted.reason: EEG, not MRI; do not treat as structural MRI datasets.

excluded_or_not_counted.name: NLM Mendeley tsy6rbc5d4
excluded_or_not_counted.reason: Catalog description matches OASIS-2 (150 subjects/373 sessions), so not a new independent cohort.

excluded_or_not_counted.reason: Primary PMC paper says Zenodo under embargo/reasonable request; no immediate public raw MRI confirmed.
